propositions: FILE_IMPACT tri-state contract (undeclared, paths, none) is implemented but lacks complete author-facing documentation at four key locations: plan-review-gate, ticket-model, event-schema, and the packaged writing-a-passing-plan guide.

The three persisted states have distinct semantics: undeclared is unscoped whole-HEAD freshness, paths is dependency-scoped to declared files with optional reason cleared, and none is authenticated empty dependency set with substantive reason explaining why no repository file changes occur.

Public `rebar explain plan` command must communicate the tri-state contract, the set-file-impact command syntax, the no-file-impact advisory LLM review, and author guidance that docs-only and test-only work use paths and none requires explaining both why and where output lives.

FILE_IMPACT replacement semantics atomically update all three derived fields: transition to paths clears any none reason, transition to none clears prior paths, transition to undeclared clears both paths and reason.

Standalone documentation verification requires durable semantic checklist with path:line evidence and semantic paraphrase, not source-grep or snapshot tests, to prove the live public behavior contract independent of documentation source structure.

Documentation-only and test-only repository changes declare paths scope; acceptance criteria are verified through RED-first public CLI test, manual semantic evidence table with reviewer timestamp and commit SHA, and scope restriction to _guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md under src/rebar.
